source_text: Jude, servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, to those who are called, beloved in God the Father and kept in Jesus Christ.
Mercy and peace to you, and may you be filled with love.

Beloved, it is with great concern that I write to you about our shared salvation. I found it necessary to write to you to entreat you to contend for the faith once delivered to the saints. For certain wicked men have entered in secretly, who were appointed long ago for this judgment - using the grace of our God as an excuse for all kinds of self-indulgence and extravagance - and denying our only Lord and Master, Jesus Christ.

I want to remind you, although you know this, that the Lord, having once saved the people out of the land of Egypt, later allowed those who did not believe to perish. He has reserved even the angles - who did not stay in their initial place, but left their appointed dwelling - for judgment on that great day, to be imprisoned for eternity in the dark gloom.
Just as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the surrounding villages - which perused all forms of sexual pleasure and unnatural acts - are likewise made an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

In a similar manner, these daydreamers defile their bodies, despise authority and blaspheme the glorious ones. Even the arch angle Michael, when he had a contentious dispute with the Devil over the body of Moses, did not dare to pronounce a judgment of blasphemy, but simply said: “”The Lord reprimand you””. But these blaspheme whatever they do not understand, and are corrupted like dumb animals by those things they understand by natural instinct.

Misery and suffering to those who follow the way of Cain, and have given themselves over to the deception of Balaam for the sake of lavish rewards, and who died in the rebellion of Korah. These people bring dishonour on you when you eat together, partying with you and gorging themselves without fear. They are clouds without water, blown about by the wind, trees in late autumn, but yet without fruit; twice dead and only fit to be uprooted. They are waves tossed about by the sea, spewing out their own confusion and shame - wandering stars, for whom the eternal tumult of darkness has been reserved.

Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied concerning them, saying: “”Behold, the Lord comes with thousands of his saints to mete out judgment upon all, and to reprove every soul of all the evil and wicked things they have done, and of all the hard words irreverent transgressors have said against him.”” Such are discontent grumblers, complainers, walking after their own lustful desires, their mouths full of proud and arrogant words, flattering people of importance for the sake of what they can gain.

But you, beloved, remember the words preached to you by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ; when they said to you: “”In the last times, mockers will come, walking according to their own wicked longings and lustful desires.”” They cause divisions among you, like carnal creatures, not having the Spirit.

But you, beloved, build yourselves up in your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit, keep yourselves in the love of God, waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ, and eternal life. Show mercy to those who doubt and dispute, save some by snatching them out of the fire; others, show mercy with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the sensuousness of the carnal nature.

Now, to him who is able to keep you without sin, and to present you in the presence of his glory without spot or blemish and with great rejoicing; to the one and only God our saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, magnificence, supreme authority and power, from time immemorial, now, and for ever and ever. Amen.
